notes.title: Version 1.00b
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Here is another small patch. It should fix some minor issues.

List of changes :
[list]
    [*]Removed a speedrun trick in Salpetre Gulch
    [*]Fixed Treacle Gnat's and Heavy Knight's behaviours
    [*]Juli should now be able to complete Into the Depths at higher difficulties
    [*]Removed a very rude Spiderling in Brimstone Sanctuary
    [*]Various tiny tweaks to level design.
[/list] 
Please contact us through email or Steam Community if you run into any issues or bugs, and have fun!
